jobs.description:
About the Role
We are seeking an SRE / DevOps Engineer to join an agile team developing and operating business-critical connected vehicle services. You will bridge development and operations to maximize uptime, automate workflows, and maintain robust monitoring for millions of connected vehicles worldwide.
What You Will Do
Observability: Maintain and optimize monitoring, logging, and alerting (Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana) for rapid troubleshooting and high availability.

Automation & IaC: Streamline operations and deployments using scripting (Python/Bash) and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform).

Operations: Run and support enterprise Linux environments and core AWS infrastructure; participate in the team's on-call rotation.

Collaboration & Security: Partner with engineers and product owners in a "you build it, you run it" culture while applying cloud security best practices (IAM, encryption).

Qualifications & Experience
Core Requirements:

AWS & Cloud Infrastructure: Solid hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in AWS, including Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).

Automation & Scripting: Strong skills in operational automation using languages such as Python, Bash, or Java.

Observability & Reliability: Proven experience setting up distributed metrics, logging, and alerts (e.g. Datadog, CloudWatch, or Kibana).

Linux & Operations: Confident working in enterprise Linux environments with a solid grasp of basic networking (TCP/IP).

Ways of Working: Good understanding of modern DevOps culture, incident management, and agile delivery.

Communication: Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Meriting:

Experience with Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) or message brokers (MQTT, Kafka).

Familiarity with container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) or backend development in Java.

Prior experience from the automotive, telematics, or IoT domain.

Who You Are
An analytical problem solver focused on automation, root-cause resolution, and continuous improvement.

A communicative team player who takes ownership of production systems and bridges technical depth with business needs.

We are looking for consultants who are passionate about modern cloud technology, eager to tackle challenging client assignments, and drive technical excellence. Join us to work alongside leading technology companies and explore cutting-edge solutions in a supportive and innovative network.
We look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT COGNIZANT
Cognizant is a leading global technology and professional services company that drives digital transformation for enterprises worldwide. We combine deep industry expertise, advanced technology capabilities, and human-centered design to solve complex business challenges. We're proud to partner with Google on mission-critical projects like Google Maps, where accuracy and attention to detail directly impact millions of users globally.

THE ROLE
Are you detail-oriented with a passion for geographic accuracy? Join our team as a Locality Expert, where you'll verify and validate Maps Data to ensure it reflects real-world changes. You'll audit critical geographic attributes—locations, names, platforms, entrances, exits, and transit positions across different transportation modes—by comparing them against trustworthy sources via web research. Your work ensures millions of users have accurate, real-time geographic information.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Audit Maps Data against real-world conditions and trustworthy sources to verify accuracy. You'll evaluate and update critical geographic attributes, work independently while managing your performance metrics, and meet defined SLA/TAT timelines. You'll also identify opportunities for improvement and communicate insights to your team lead, contributing to continuous quality enhancement.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience / Skills
● 3+ years of experience in the automotive industry or Urban planning, Traffics/ Transit/ Signals/ Signages
● Strong understanding of market research methodologies and techniques.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Local language and in English
● Native / Bilingual (B2+) in Swedish language
● Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
● Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Excellent time management and organizational skills.
● Strong analytical, excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Nice-to-have skills include experience with vector data analysis, basic GIS map component knowledge, and PL/SQL basics.

WHY JOIN US?
Make global impact every day—your work directly influences how millions of people navigate the world. You'll develop specialized expertise in geospatial data quality within a team dedicated to excellence. Join Cognizant and grow with a global technology leader offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Become a specialist in a rapidly growing field of data quality assurance.
